prompt: A desktop landing page for Syed Hammad's personal portfolio website, rendered edge to edge at 1440 wide with crisp readable text, no browser window, no device, no desk. Syed is an AI Engineer in Bengaluru who builds LLM systems on enterprise data: NL2SQL and Graph RAG retrieval. A recruiter must know who he is and how to reach him in one glance. This comp is graph-led and goes further: a retrieval knowledge graph is the ground of the whole first viewport. Dozens of small ink nodes with thin edges spread across the page; a handful are labelled in tiny monospace with real fragments: 'question', 'schema', 'NL2SQL', 'graph RAG', 'answer'. One orange path travels from a node labelled 'Who builds this?' across the page and ends at the name, as if the graph retrieved him. The name 'Syed Hammad' sits large in a high-contrast display serif at the end of that path, 'Hammad' in italic, with a small tracked label above it: 'AI ENGINEER. DATA SCIENTIST. BUILDER. BASED IN BENGALURU'. Beneath, one line: 'I build AI that understands enterprise data.' and two pill buttons 'Explore my work' and 'Start a conversation'. Slim top bar: wordmark at left, 'Work', 'About', 'Process', 'Journey', pill 'Let's talk' at right. A hairline proof row at the bottom: 'Since 2019', '+24% recommendation accuracy', '+8% forecast precision', 'Eurofins / NuMinds AI'. Visual law: near-black ground, warm off-white ink, muted stone grey secondary text, a single warm orange accent for the retrieved path only. Display serif headlines with one italic word, geometric sans body, tiny tracked monospace labels, hairline rules. Editorial and calm, not neon, no glow.
